run_clean_single_checkpoint: run the script to clean a single checkpoint file by removing the backbone prefix
run_clean_directory_checkpoints: run the script to clean all checkpoint files in a directory recursively
run_parse_args_validation: run the argument parser to validate checkpoint_dir or checkpoint_path inputs
run_load_checkpoint_with_prefix: run the mmengine loader to load a checkpoint with the backbone prefix stripped
run_save_cleaned_checkpoint: run torch save to write a cleaned checkpoint with the _clean suffix
